chain.label: No means to verify elevator not jammed
chain.trigger: the elevator system (by design) has no gust lock...lack of a means to enable flight crews...to verify before takeoff that the elevators are not jammed

chain.label: Evacuation slide cable misinstalled
chain.trigger: the cable had been installed incorrectly in the valve assembly, which prevented proper inflation

chain.label: Airplane parked 2 days in high gusting wind
chain.trigger: the airplane had been parked on the ramp at YIP for 2 days near a large hangar, and the elevators...were exposed to high, gusting surface wind conditions

chain.label: Hangar-induced turbulence on parked elevator
chain.trigger: the airflow at the airplane's parked location was affected by the presence of the large hangar that generated localized turbulence with a vertical component that moved the elevator surfaces rapidly up and down

caused_by.evidence: the effect of a large structure on the gusting surface wind at the airplane's parked location, which led to turbulent gust loads on the right elevator

chain.label: Right elevator jammed full trailing-edge-down
chain.trigger: the right elevator's geared tab's inboard actuating crank and links had moved beyond their normal range of travel and became locked overcenter, effectively jamming the right elevator in a full-TED position...the right elevator did not move, remaining about -16° TED

caused_by.evidence: impacts against the elevator mechanical stops, imposing dynamic loads sufficient to jam the right elevator

chain.label: Overran runway after late rejected takeoff
chain.trigger: the captain executed the rejected takeoff 12 seconds after the airplane achieved V1...the airplane overran the departure end of runway 23L

caused_by.evidence: the airplane did not respond in pitch when the captain pulled on the control column...By the time the captain recognized that the airplane would not rotate and called to abort the takeoff, 12 seconds had elapsed since V1, essentially guaranteeing that the airplane would overrun the runway
the lack of a means to enable the flight crew to detect a jammed elevator during preflight checks for the Boeing MD-83 airplane

chain.label: 1R door evacuation slide failed to inflate
chain.trigger: the evacuation slide for the airplane's right front (1R) door did not inflate when a flight attendant pulled the manual inflation handle, which rendered the exit unusable

caused_by.evidence: chafe marks inside the pulley housing...it was possible to incorrectly install the valve release cable in the pulley housing such that the ball end would catch

chain.label: Passenger sustained minor injury in evacuation
chain.trigger: One passenger received a minor injury, and the airplane sustained substantial damage

caused_by.evidence: one reported minor injury (a leg laceration that required sutures)
